target: Qt 4.8.7 (Carbon, all modules) with OpenSSL 1.0.2u on Mac OS X 10.2 Jaguar / PowerPC: shared application suite (milestone 4)

build.recipe: scripts/build/qt4-macos-jaguar/Dockerfile.qt (image qt4-jaguar-qt-probe), rebuilt from scratch; build-openssl.sh, build-qt.sh, then build-suite.sh
build.openssl: OpenSSL 1.0.2u, static, no-asm, no-dso (build-openssl.sh); its command line tool passes check-imports.py (openssl-jaguar-imports.txt)
build.configure: the module set of the Tiger build with -openssl-linked: QtCore, QtGui, QtNetwork, QtSql (static SQLite plugin), QtXml, QtXmlPatterns, QtSvg, QtScript, QtScriptTools, QtDeclarative, QtOpenGL, QtMultimedia, Qt3Support, QtTest, QtUiTools; -no-iconv
build.import_checks: check-imports.py passes for all 25 executables (24 applications and smoke-runner)
build.weak_references: direct-weak-references.txt and qtgui-direct-weak-references.txt are empty: outside the reviewed QtCore guards, the QtGui shim and QGLPixelBuffer, no Qt object references a weak import

findings: Every application links against the 10.2.8 SDK after: SQLite without its AFP locking style (fsctl, srandomdev), WTF atomics through GCC builtins below a 10.4 target (OSAtomic), Q3Dns on the BIND 8 resolver in libSystem (libresolv is 10.3), and getlogin() for getlogin_r in Q3FileDialog.
QGLPixelBuffer reports no pixel buffers on 10.2 (AGL pbuffers are 10.3) instead of calling NULL.
QRegion::fromHIShapeRef and QMacStyle resolved HIShapeGetAsQDRgn and HIShapeGetBounds through QLibrary, which cannot load anything on 10.2; they fall back to the functions themselves, which 10.2 has.
A frameless window used a document window without title bar, which 10.2 rejects (-5601); it is a plain window there.
QSystemTrayIcon called -[NSStatusItem drawStatusBarBackgroundInRect:withHighlight:] and -[NSView setHidden:], both 10.3; the calls are skipped where the method does not exist.

Qt's monotonic clock on the Mac computed mach_absolute_time() * numer / denom in 64 bits. On PowerPC numer is 10^9, so the product overflows after minutes of uptime and the clock jumps back; qt_safe_select then reported a timeout to QProcess::waitForFinished seconds after the start. This also affects Tiger on PowerPC (patches/qt4/macos/all/11-ppc-timebase-overflow.patch).
The guest display must stay awake during the run; the host sent a key every 90 s.
Skipped on 10.2 but not on Tiger: GLSL shader programs and vertex buffers (the emulated OpenGL renderer of 10.2 has neither).
Drag and drop: the QtGui probe check dnd/drag-pasteboard passes on 10.2, 10.2.8 and 10.4; the G3 run used the previous build of the same day, which did not yet have the drag bridge.
TLS: the loopback handshake negotiates TLS 1.2 with the selected AES128-GCM-SHA256 on all three systems; OpenSSL needs no-dso because its DSO layer calls dlopen.
